positions.description:
As an intern I helped in the ongoing development of a  product which implements hybrid homomorphic cryptography. 
In order to do this I studied academic papers on the subject, and tested Cryptdb (an experimental implementation of homomorphic cryptography) in order to asses the technology's limitations and its applicability to Century's client needs.
